paths.description: Paths in the repository the change touches; read against its manifest and IaC index where it has one

provider.description: Who assigns providerId: github, gitlab or other

providerId.description: The provider's id for the repository, such as GitHub's repository id. Consulted before repositoryKey, and survives a rename (#88)

repositoryKey.description: Key of the Repository that is about to change, e.g. github.com/acme/payments. This or providerId is required

sha.description: The commit of the change, 4 to 64 hex characters. Keeps only deployments whose Artifact CONTAINS a Change it names (changeScope applied); unknown when no Change in the repository matches it (#85)

asOf.description: Read the graph as it was at this instant (ISO-8601), rather than now

budget.description: The most nodes the pack may hold, the start left out: 1 to 500

startId.description: The node to start from, as Type:key

template.description: The traversal template to walk, one of those GET /api/v1/ontology lists under templates

deployedAt.description: ISO-8601 instant, absent when the deployment records none

lineage.description: known, or unknown when no artifact of the deployment CONTAINS a Change

dryRun.description: Preview the merge: everything is done and then rolled back, so nothing changes

into.description: The node to merge into: a key of the same type, or a full Type:key id

from.description: The id of the node merged, which is retired as merged and whose key now resolves to the node merged into

gained.description: Properties the node merged into took from the merged node, which it lacked

into.description: The id of the node merged into, which stays

kept.description: Properties both held with different values, where the value of the node merged into stays

previousKeys.description: Every key the node merged into has been known by, now including the merged node's

redirected.description: Nodes merged earlier into the merged node, now pointing at the node merged into

ServiceNowCI.description: A configuration item, in the shape this endpoint has always returned

At most `budget` (1..500) nodes are returned; `truncated` and `cut` say how many were left out. Each node and edge carries a provenance summary, and each edge its manifest, rule or commitSha where it has one. `asOf` reads the graph as it was then.
